verses.1: Paul, called apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and his brother Sosthenes
verses.2: To the church of God, those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, who reside in Corinth, and to all those who are called to bear the name of our Lord Jesus Christ everywhere they go.
verses.3: May grace and peace be upon us from our God the Father and from Jesus Christ.
verses.4: I thank my God always for the grace that God has given you in Christ Jesus.
verses.5: Because in every respect, you became enriched through him; in every matter of speech and knowledge as well.
verses.6: Since the martyrdom of Christ has been confirmed among you,
verses.7: So that you may not be deceived by any gifts, having come to know the truth about our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.8: Who will also ensure that you are completely free from guilt on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.9: The Lord is faithful, through whom you were chosen to be part of the fellowship with His Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord.
verses.10: I ask you, brothers, to keep the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in mind, so that everyone may speak of it. Do not allow any divisions or conflicts to arise among you, whether in your thoughts or actions.
verses.11: It has been told me, my brothers, by the Chloeans that you are indeed deceitful.
verses.12: I say this because each of you will say it themselves. I am Paul, I am Apollos, I am Cefas, I am Christ.
verses.13: Was Christ crucified? Was Paul crucified for you, or did you receive baptism in his name?
verses.14: I am grateful that I didn’t baptize any of you, except for Krispon and Gaion.
verses.15: So that no one should say that they were baptized in my name.
verses.16: I also baptized Stéphanos’ house. I don’t know if I baptized anyone else as well.
verses.17: For Christ did not send me to baptize people, but to preach the good news. He did this not with words of wisdom, so that the cross of Christ might not be in vain.
verses.18: For the word of the cross is a source of strength for those who are healed from their sins. But for us who are still in need of healing, it is God’s power that provides us with strength.
verses.19: For it is written: “I will abandon the wisdom of the wise, and I will reject the counsel of the intelligent.”
verses.20: Who is wise? Who is the messenger of God? Who is the discuser of this world’s problems? Has not God withheld wisdom from the world?
verses.21: For in the wisdom of God, the world did not recognize God through His wisdom. Therefore, God pleased to save those who believed through the foolishness of His message.
verses.22: For even the Jews seek signs, and the Greeks seek wisdom.
verses.23: We proclaim Christ, who was crucified. The Jews, however, consider us scoundrels and fools.
verses.24: But to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, may they receive the power of Christ and the wisdom of God.
verses.25: For the son of God is wiser than men, and the weakling of God is stronger than men.
verses.26: See, brothers, that there are not many wise people in terms of physical strength, not many strong ones, and not many noble ones.
verses.27: But God chose the weak among the world’s people, so that they might humble the wise. And God also chose the poor among the world’s people, so that they might humble the strong.
verses.28: And the most noble and worthy things in the world, as well as those things that are beyond human comprehension, God chose to eliminate them, so that the things that exist could be destroyed.
verses.29: So that no animal may boast in front of the God.
verses.30: From Him, therefore, you belong to Christ Jesus. He became our wisdom from God; he is also righteousness, sanctification, and redemption.
verses.31: As it is written: The one who boasts in the presence of others will be boasted about by them.
